summary: In the Lab standalone answer demo, empty Apply clears the seeded answer and LaTeX output. Escape and a browser pointer down on the backdrop close an edited dialog and leave the answer unchanged; reopen starts from the answer, not the dismissed 9. In the rich editor, empty Block Math Apply leaves the HTML unchanged. Block Math toolbar + 9 + Apply inserts one centered block in the editor, one table row and one cleaned block-math HTML node. The live descendant probe counted two matching nodes; the saved HTML and visible editor each show one. Three PNGs cover full 2156px page; reload exactly restores baseline. Master93; Lab local only.

observations.result: Normal empty Apply clears previous answer and KaTeX source output.
Escape and backdrop dismiss without applying. Sidebar was visually above backdrop and won two hit-tests; no sidebar link clicked.
Empty insertion produces no node. Real block toolbar produces clean block-math DIV and visible KaTeX. Full vertical evidence and exact local baseline restoration.
